question: What tap density did the NFA powders have?

trace.query: SELECT id, page, text FROM lines WHERE text ILIKE '%tap%' OR text ILIKE '%density%' ORDER BY page, line_no
SELECT id, page, text FROM atoms WHERE text ILIKE '%tap d%' OR text ILIKE '%tapped%' OR text ILIKE '%g cm%' OR text ILIKE '%g/cm%' OR text ILIKE '%g cm−3%' OR text ILIKE '%g cm^%'

SELECT 'cell' k, id, text FROM cells WHERE text ILIKE '%tap%' OR text ILIKE '%g cm%' UNION ALL SELECT 'fact', id, statement FROM figure_facts WHERE statement ILIKE '%tap%' OR statement ILIKE '%density%' UNION ALL SELECT 'ocr', id, text FROM figure_ocr WHERE text ILIKE '%tap%'
SELECT id, page, text FROM lines WHERE text ILIKE '%powder%' AND (text ILIKE '%packing%' OR text ILIKE '%bulk%' OR text ILIKE '%volumetric%' OR text ILIKE '%tap%')

SELECT id, page, text FROM lines WHERE text ILIKE '%cm%3%' OR text ILIKE '%g cc%' OR text ILIKE '%g/cc%' OR text ILIKE '%packing%' OR text ILIKE '%bulk%' OR text ILIKE '%tap%' OR text ILIKE '%physical%'
